title: Decision — rasa.module.notes (records-family/1)
description: A ratified decision: tier 2 of the note -> decision -> canon ladder. One file under notes/decisions/, the ruling as its H1 and a non-empty `## Basis`. FROZEN from the moment it is recorded: only `updated`, `promoted_to` and `promoted` may change. A decision is changed by superseding it, never by editing it.

created.description: The day the decision was ratified.

supersedes.description: The older decision(s) this one replaces. 'Superseded' is derived from here; the older file is never edited.

sources.description: What the decision was promoted from or rests on: notes, threads, events, tasks...

promoted_to.description: Where it became canon: one of config `canon_target`, optionally with a #section.
